data.name: Irresistible Demand
data.description: At 8th level, you can force others to do your bidding. As a standard action, you attempt to dominate a creature as though using the dominate monster spell, except that the creature must have no greater than %1 Hit Dice. The targeted creature receives a Will save DC %2 each round to negate the effect. You can dominate creatures for a %3 rounds per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive. You must concentrate as a standard action to maintain control over a dominated creature.|ControllerIrresistibleDemandHD|ControllerIrresistibleDemandDC|ControllerIrresistibleDemandRounds
